title: IP based throttling condition
description: IPCondition schema from WSO2 API Manager

ipConditionType.description: Type of the IP condition. Allowed values are "IPRANGE" and "IPSPECIFIC"

specificIP.description: Specific IP when "IPSPECIFIC" is used as the ipConditionType

startingIP.description: Staring IP when "IPRANGE" is used as the ipConditionType

endingIP.description: Ending IP when "IPRANGE" is used as the ipConditionType
